description: Six decision classes (r1..r6) for the TeamHarness decision surface. Data only - no runtime code references this file. Class boundaries are derived from the decision points that exist in mcp/server.py @ d8332e0a; the per-class recommended_action is a W1 proposal chosen from the fixed vocabulary and is not enforced anywhere.

classes.name: task_result_acceptance
classes.description: The trusted Leader accepts or rejects a submitted task result (projectflow accept_task_result). Fenced by the task's submission identity: submissionId must match the current submission, and the persisted task result digest must match its structured result; a mismatched fence is refused. Result status must match what was submitted.

classes.name: task_cancellation
classes.description: Cancelling a task (taskflow cancel_task): leader role, explicit reason, submission fence for already-submitted tasks, durable cancellation fields (cancel_reason, replacement_task_id, cancelled_at), and an idempotent committed-cancellation retry path (cancelled + cancelled_at + matching reason stays ok).

classes.name: reassignment
classes.description: Re-delegating a task to a DIFFERENT assignee is a new delegation attempt, not a retry of a lost one: the per-attempt nonce and Matrix transaction id (delegate-{task_id}-{nonce}, pre-minted and persisted before send) rotate on re-delegation (including A->B->A), while a retry of the same attempt reuses the recorded identity and dedupes.

classes.name: loop_review_verdict
classes.description: The per-iteration review verdict of a Loop project: the record_loop_iteration review variant (emitter 'record_loop_iteration:review', event SIG-VERDICT, origin critic_verdict) decides whether the loop continues with the next iteration or stops.

classes.name: project_lifecycle
classes.description: Project-level control decisions: pause_project / resume_project / complete_project - the Go Controller intervention family (event SIG-DECISION, origin decision_lock). Mutating actions refuse to continue on stale local state after a failed authoritative pull so a Controller pause/resume/replan is never clobbered; complete_project is idempotent and withholds the PROJECT_COMPLETED notification when the shared-storage sync fails.

classes.name: attention_escalation
classes.description: Raising a blocker or question to the leader and human members via taskflow request_attention with kind one of approval, decision, escalation, other (Matrix transaction attention-{task_id}-{kind}-{attempt}); the recorded event id is reused on an exact retry.
classes.note: kind=other is informational and maps to audit_only (no decision required)
